snippet.title: Templar Assault - New Multi-Move Feature
snippet.description: The newest update of Templar Assault features a new Multi-Move capability, allowing you to hustle your Templar Squad to the action twice as fast.  When moving straight ahead, you can achieve what used to take multiple clicks with a single touch.  This new feature is one of multiple new enhancements around the map and movement that will be coming out over the next month, and really help us get StoryTeller ready for other secret projects.
